lines.text: Emma expected the Grand Canyon to be warm.
At the South Rim there was snow, and the first switchbacks below the rim were packed ice.
In winter the upper trails can stay icy long after a storm, even when it's milder down in the canyon.
The park recommends traction devices on icy trails.
She turned around, came back the next morning with microspikes, and checked conditions first.
Save this before your winter trip.
